empty.noActiveDownloadsDesc: Start a model download from the Recommended Models dialog or Model Manager.

tooltip.cancelledChip: Download was cancelled. You can restart it from the model browser.
tooltip.totalSize: Total size of files being downloaded
tooltip.fileCount: Number of files downloaded vs total files
tooltip.cancelHint: Stop the current download. You can restart it later.
tooltip.stalledDisconnected: WebSocket connection lost. The download may still be running on the server. Click Reconnect to restore progress updates.
tooltip.stalledNoProgress: No progress received for {{time}}. The download may have stalled or the connection was lost. Try cancelling and restarting the download.

dialog.activeInfo: Downloads continue in the background. Access them anytime from the toolbar download icon.
dialog.idleInfoUseRecommended: Download models using the Recommended Models button inside nodes.
dialog.idleInfoModelManager: The Model Manager in the top right panel shows all available models.

notice.cacheLocation: Models will be downloaded to your local cache folder in the standard location for Huggingface and Ollama.
notice.gatedModels: Gated or private Hugging Face models need access on huggingface.co (accept the license or request access) plus a read token for the server process: set HF_TOKEN before starting NodeTool, or run huggingface-cli login once. If a download fails, open the progress panel and use Copy message to share the details.
